title: Build an AI Study Assistant: Prompts, Examples and Fact Checks | Ep 48
description:
Build an AI Study Assistant: Prompts, Examples and Fact Checks. Learn with a simple example and a beginner exercise.

AI for Beginners — Episode 48 of 50

What you will learn: Combine prompts, examples and verification in a learning workflow.
Example: a study helper that quizzes on photosynthesis.
Try it: build a five-question quiz and check answers.
Remember: keep it educational and verify scientific explanations.

Follow the series in episode order and practice with sample data. Share your question or exercise result in the comments.
